description: Lists the caller's own analyses of the last 90 days, newest first, 30 per page (GET /ai-music/history): source label (file name or link), dates, state and report, never any audio. Needs an account and the queue:read scope. Pass the returned "nextBefore" as "before" for the next page. Costs no quota.

before.description: Cursor: the "nextBefore" value of the previous page.

name: jj_ai_music_history
title: List my AI music analyses of the last 90 days
